blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 10 short (mukhtasar) aur 8 long (tafseeli) sawal hain. Har sawal ke saath bracket mein likha hai ke us ka jawab kis lesson mein hai.

items: Python programming mein GUI ka bunyadi maqsad: (a) Software chalane ke liye aasan (user-friendly) interface banana (b) Python mein files sambhalna (c) Network ke kaam sambhalna (d) Database mein data rakhna aur nikalna
Python ka built-in GUI toolkit: (a) wxPython (b) Tkinter (c) PyQt (d) Kivy
Text dikhane wala Tkinter widget: (a) Button (b) Label (c) Entry (d) Listbox
Tkinter mein pack() method ka kaam: (a) Widgets ko aik ke neeche aik ya saath saath rakhna (b) Widgets ko rows aur columns mein rakhna (c) Widgets ka size khud set karna (d) Pop-up windows banana
Tkinter mein widgets tarteeb dene ke methods: (a) grid() (b) pack() (c) place() (d) Upar wale sab

Tkinter mein event-driven programming ka matlab: (a) Aisa code jo user input ke baghair chale (b) Aisa code jo click ya key press jaise user ke kaam ka jawab de (c) Database queries sambhalne ka code (d) Network requests sambhalne ka code
User se input lene wala Tkinter widget: (a) Label (b) Button (c) Entry (d) Listbox
Woh layout manager jo coordinates se widgets ko bilkul theek jagah rakhta hai: (a) pack() (b) grid() (c) place() (d) align()
Button click ko function se jorne wala Tkinter option: (a) bind() (b) configure() (c) command= (brackets ke baghair) (d) execute()
Database mein CRUD ka matlab: (a) Create, Read, Update, Delete (b) Create, Run, Upload, Delete (c) Copy, Retrieve, Upload, Download (d) Create, Remove, Update, Manage

Tkinter kya hai aur yeh Python ka built-in GUI toolkit kyun hai? (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter mein window kaise banate aur frames kaise dalte hain? (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter ke do aam widgets ke naam likhein. (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter mein layout management ka maqsad kya hai? (jawab: 4.1)
pack() method Tkinter mein cheezein kaise tarteeb deta hai? (jawab: 4.1)
Event-driven programming kya hai aur Tkinter mein kaise istemal hoti hai? (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter mein user input kaise sambhalte hain? (jawab: 4.1)
Database management mein CRUD operation kya hai? (jawab: 4.2)
Python ko SQLite jaise database se kaise jorte hain? (jawab: 4.2)
GUI ka concept samjhaiye aur application banane mein is ki ahmiyat bataiye. (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter ko Python ke built-in GUI toolkit ke taur par bayan karein. (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter ke aham components aur widgets kaun se hain? (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter mein layout management kya hai, aur pack(), grid() aur place() se cheezein kaise tarteeb di jati hain? (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter mein saaf aur responsive interfaces kaise design karte hain? (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter mein event-driven programming ka concept samjhaiye. (jawab: 4.1)
Tkinter mein user input kaise sambhalte aur widgets ko functions se kaise jorte hain? (jawab: 4.1)
SQLite ya MySQL se Python ko database se jorne ka tareeqa bayan karein. (jawab: 4.2)
